_comment: Differences between the C version and the Rust version that the gate accepts. status 'accepted': kept on purpose. status 'open': tracked in rust/doc/DIFFERENCES-FROM-C.*.md and must shrink: the patch that fixes it deletes its entry here (a stale entry fails the gate). 'pattern' is a regular expression searched in a line of the output of softflowd_test.py --strict.

entries.pattern: -v 10 -a -b(?: -T ether)?: DIFFERENT: (?:datagram \d+: \d+ bytes from A|\d+ datagrams from A)
entries.reason: ICMP is never a Biflow in C; the reverse icmpTypeCode of the C template is not copied
the option data record ignores -e (hard-coded zeros)
-b with -H: reverse-direction MAC, and sizes with -v 10

entries.pattern: the log of the (?:shutdown|exit) command: DIFFERENT
entries.reason: log lines of the control commands
extra log line at a signal

entries.pattern: command lines that are wrong: \d+ of \d+ DIFFER
entries.reason: texts of the command line errors
texts of the command line errors and -h
the sum of the lines above; every differing run has its own line that is checked
